news.title: Intel slides as TSMC explores role in Musk's Terafab venture
news.text: Reports that TSMC is in early talks to join Elon Musk's Terafab chip project in Texas sent Intel shares down as much as ~4% premarket — Intel joined Terafab in April 2026 as the sole named manufacturing partner, and a TSMC role would dilute that position. Musk confirmed the talks are at an early stage.

news.title: Goldman names tactical chip-sector buys ahead of Q3 earnings
news.text: Goldman Sachs flagged Applied Materials, Seagate and Microchip as tactical buys into earnings season, expecting AMAT to raise margin targets at SEMICON West (13 Oct) on DRAM/advanced-logic strength; flagged Qualcomm, KLA and Western Digital as relative underperformers. Backdrop: Goldman sees ~27% y/y S&P 500 EPS growth this quarter, led by tech and energy.

news.title: Yields ease off multiyear highs; Fed minutes due Tuesday
news.text: The 10-year Treasury yield eased to ~5.26% (from last week's selloff highs) ahead of Tuesday's FOMC minutes release. WTI crude slipped ~0.5% to $90.68/bbl while Brent rose ~0.6% to $102.90/bbl — oil and yields remain the two forces investors are watching most with earnings season still a week out.

news.title: Travel headwinds build ahead of Delta's 9 Oct earnings
news.text: A 5 Oct US Travel Association report projects roughly 2 million fewer international visitors to the US in 2026 vs 2025, citing airfare/accommodation costs and visa-processing delays — a sector headwind for Delta heading into its 9 Oct Q3 print. TD Cowen trimmed its DAL price target to $101 from $105 while keeping a Buy rating; shares are still up ~22% YTD on premium-seat demand.
